E0001.title: The case file cannot be read
E0001.fix: Fix the file at the reported location.

E0002.title: The case file does not define exactly one case

E0003.title: The case document does not match the schema
E0003.fix: Correct the field named in the message.

E0101.title: Inconsistent mesh array sizes
E0101.fix: Regenerate the mesh with the meshing tool; the file or partition is corrupt.

E0102.title: Mesh index out of range
E0102.fix: Regenerate the mesh; an index points past the end of its array.

E0103.title: Face with fewer than 3 nodes
E0103.fix: Remove or repair the degenerate face in the meshing tool.

E0104.title: Face with a repeated node
E0104.fix: Repair the face in the meshing tool so each node appears once.

E0105.title: Face with the same cell on both sides
E0105.fix: Repair the mesh connectivity in the meshing tool.

E0106.title: Cell with too few faces
E0106.fix: Repair the cell in the meshing tool, or regenerate the partition.

E0107.title: Cell not closed
E0107.fix: Repair the cell in the meshing tool: its faces must enclose a volume.

D0107.title: Divergence
D0107.fix: Lower the CFL number or use a more dissipative limiter; check the mesh quality near the cell.

E0108.title: Face shared by more than two cells
E0108.fix: Repair non-manifold faces in the meshing tool.

E0109.title: Face does not match its zone's role
E0109.fix: Put interior and boundary faces in separate zones in the meshing tool.

E0110.title: Duplicate zone name
E0110.fix: Rename one of the zones in the meshing tool; `interior`, `unassigned` and `fluid` are reserved.

E0111.title: Labelled face not found
E0111.fix: Regenerate the mesh; a zone references a face that does not exist.

E0112.title: Empty mesh
E0112.fix: Check that the file is the intended mesh and was exported completely.

E0113.title: Mesh too large
E0113.fix: Partition the mesh, or use a build with 64-bit indices.

E0114.title: Inverted cell
E0114.fix: Repair the inverted cell in the meshing tool.

E0115.title: Face labelled twice
E0115.fix: Assign each face to one zone in the meshing tool.

E0117.title: Duplicate or negative global cell id
E0117.fix: Regenerate the partition; global cell ids must be unique and non-negative.

E0118.title: Invalid periodic pair
E0118.fix: Fix the periodic declaration in the meshing tool: each periodic zone in exactly one pair, with a non-zero translation.

E0119.title: Periodic faces do not match
E0119.fix: Regenerate the mesh with conforming periodic faces, and check the translation.

E0120.title: Degenerate face
E0120.fix: Repair the face in the meshing tool; it has no area.

E0121.title: Non-positive cell volume
E0121.fix: Repair the cell in the meshing tool; it is inverted or flat.

E0130.title: Mesh file cannot be opened
E0130.fix: Check the path and the file permissions.

E0131.title: Unknown mesh format
E0131.fix: Export the mesh as CGNS, Gmsh, Fluent .msh or an OpenFOAM polyMesh.

E0132.title: Malformed mesh file
E0132.fix: Re-export the mesh; the file does not follow its format specification.

E0133.title: Unsupported mesh feature
E0133.fix: Export the mesh without the feature named in the message.

E0134.title: Mesh refers to another file
E0134.fix: Export a self-contained mesh (no CGNS links to other files).

E0135.title: Entity in several zones
E0135.fix: Assign each entity to one zone in the meshing tool.

E0136.title: Zone groups file unreadable
E0136.fix: Fix the file against docs/contracts/mesh-info.md, or remove it.

E0137.title: Zone groups file describes another mesh
E0137.fix: Regenerate the groups for this mesh, then the MeshInfo and the solver input.

E0138.title: Bad zone group
E0138.fix: Correct the group against the zone names of the mesh's MeshInfo.

E0140.title: Invalid partition request
E0140.fix: Ask for 1 to N parts (N = number of cells), one rank per part, and a weight of at least 1 per cell.

E0141.title: Mesh already partitioned
E0141.fix: Partition the global mesh, not one of its partitions.

E0142.title: Partitioner unavailable or failed
E0142.fix: Use a build with the partitioner enabled, or choose the other partitioning method.

E0143.title: Empty partition
E0143.fix: Run on fewer ranks, or relax the cell weights.

E0144.title: Inconsistent halo
E0144.fix: Launch one MPI rank per part, each with the partition extracted for its own rank.

E0145.title: Device halo exchange unsupported
E0145.fix: Use a build with CUDA enabled and a CUDA-aware MPI, such as the dev image.

E0146.title: Several ranks without MPI
E0146.fix: Run this build on one rank, or use a build with MPI, such as the dev image.

E0201.title: No mesh information
E0201.fix: Pass the MeshInfo JSON: `autan plan case.py --mesh-info mesh.meshinfo.json`.

E0202.title: The MeshInfo document is invalid
E0202.fix: Regenerate the MeshInfo with the mesh reader of the same solver version.

E0203.title: The MeshInfo describes another mesh file
E0203.fix: Pass the MeshInfo of the case's mesh, or change `mesh` in the case.

W0204.title: Highly non-orthogonal cells
W0204.fix: Improve the mesh near the worst cells, or lower the CFL number.

W0205.title: Mesh file not found
W0205.fix: Put the mesh at the path the case gives, relative to the case file.

E0206.title: Manufactured solution differs from its hash
E0206.fix: Regenerate the file, or update the case's sha256 to the file the study uses.

E0207.title: Manufactured solution not found
E0207.fix: Export the manufactured solution with autan-vv and give its path.

E0208.title: Not a manufactured solution
E0208.fix: Point the case at a manufactured solution exported by autan-vv.

E0209.title: Manufactured solution does not match the case
E0209.fix: Build the case gas from the solution's parameters, or export the solution the case needs.

E0210.title: The MeshInfo's zone groups describe another groups file
E0210.fix: Regenerate the MeshInfo with `autan-mesh-info` after changing the groups file.

W0211.title: Zone groups file not found
W0211.fix: Put the groups file next to the mesh.

E0301.title: Quantity of the wrong dimension
E0301.fix: Pass a value of the expected dimension, with a unit from `autan.units`.

E0302.title: Missing unit
E0302.fix: Multiply by a unit: `19.57 * deg`, `7.0 * m`.

E0303.title: Unknown unit
E0303.fix: Write the quantity as `"<number> <unit>"`, for example `"101325 Pa"`.

E0305.title: Turbulence model needs an unsteady run

E0306.title: Freestream does not match the physics
E0306.fix: Set the freestream parameters required by the physics.

E0410.title: Boundary rule matches no zone
E0410.fix: Use one of the zone names listed by `autan plan`, or a glob that matches some.

E0411.title: Boundary zone matched by several rules
E0411.fix: Narrow the patterns so each zone matches one rule.

E0414.title: Boundary condition not available for this physics
E0414.fix: Use the condition matching the physics: `slip()` for inviscid walls, `inlet(...)` or `velocity_inlet(...)`.

W0415.title: Case overrides the mesh boundary type
W0415.fix: Check that the override is intended.

E0416.title: Boundary rules with a manufactured solution
E0416.fix: Remove the boundary rules from the verification case.

E0417.title: Unsteady verification case
E0417.fix: Set `case.time = autan.Steady(...)` in the verification case.

E0420.title: Face-state file missing or invalid
E0420.fix: Export the face states with autan-vv for this mesh and give their path and sha256.

E0421.title: Face states do not match the boundary faces
E0421.fix: Export the face states from the mesh the case uses.

E0422.title: Face states exported for another mesh
E0422.fix: Export the face states for the mesh the case uses.

E0423.title: Face states do not cover the zone
E0423.fix: Export the face states for every zone the condition applies to.

E0424.title: Condition on a periodic zone
E0424.fix: Remove the rule, or change the mesh if the zone is not meant to be periodic.

E0425.title: Point-vortex surfaces match no wall
E0425.fix: Give a pattern that matches the walls of the lifting body, e.g. `surfaces="wing.*"`.

E0426.title: Zone group pattern matches no group
E0426.fix: Use one of the group names the message lists, or select zones by name.

E0501.title: Cell zone rule matches no zone
E0501.fix: Use one of the cell zone names listed by `autan plan`.

E0502.title: Cell zone matched by several rules
E0502.fix: Narrow the patterns so each zone matches one rule.

E0504.title: Material does not match the physics
E0504.fix: Use a material of the right kind for the physics.

E0505.title: Fluids of different materials in contact
E0505.fix: Use the same material on both sides, or separate them by a solid zone.

E0506.title: Solid zone with incompressible physics
E0506.fix: Use `autan.Compressible(...)`, or remove the solid zone from the mesh.

E0507.title: Initial state does not match the physics
E0507.fix: Give the state the physics needs: `autan.State(pressure=..., temperature=..., velocity=(u, v, w))`.

E0508.title: Initial-state file missing or invalid
E0508.fix: Write the initial state with `autan.initial_state.write` for this mesh, and give its path and the SHA-256 it returns.

E0509.title: Initial state written for another mesh
E0509.fix: Write the initial state for the mesh the case uses.

E0510.title: Initial state does not cover the fluid cells
E0510.fix: Write one row per fluid cell of the mesh, at its centroid.

E0511.title: Initial states do not match the cells
E0511.fix: Write the initial state from the cell centroids of the mesh the case uses.

E0512.title: Initial-state file not available for this case
E0512.fix: Remove the zones' `initial`, the start, or the file; or use a compressible inviscid or laminar case.

E0601.title: Monitor surfaces match no boundary zone
E0601.fix: Use a pattern that matches the zones to integrate over.

E0603.title: Monitor on a periodic zone
E0603.fix: Integrate over the walls instead, or change the mesh if the zone is not meant to be periodic.

E0701.title: The run directory does not conform to autan.results/1
E0701.fix: Open a directory written by a backend of this solver version.

E0703.title: No such solution data
E0703.fix: Check `results.run.status`, and use a field name listed in the message.

E0704.title: The run failed
E0704.fix: Report the message with the run directory.

E0705.title: Invalid solver input
E0705.fix: Regenerate the input with `autan prepare` from the same Autan version as the runtime.

E0706.title: Physics not in this solver build
E0706.fix: Use a build that includes it, or change the case or the devices.

E0707.title: Previous run cannot be resumed
E0707.fix: Start from another run, or run the case from the freestream.

E0708.title: Start does not match the case
E0708.fix: Change the case, or use `warm` to start a different case from that state.

E0709.title: Start solution differs
E0709.fix: Prepare the input again from the run as it is now.

W0710.title: Exempt equation left its floor
W0710.fix: Check the boundary conditions and the mesh: a symmetric or 2D problem whose symmetry breaks during the run usually means a boundary condition breaks it.

W0801.title: No NVIDIA GPU found
W0801.fix: Install the NVIDIA driver, or run on a GPU machine.

W0802.title: No MPI launcher found
W0802.fix: Install a GPU-aware MPI (Open MPI or MPICH built with CUDA support).

W0803.title: Solver core not built
W0803.fix: Build the C++ core (see README) to run real computations.

E0804.title: No solver backend
E0804.fix: Pass one: `case.run(mesh_info, backend=autan.SolverBackend())` with autan-run installed, or `autan.FakeBackend()` for synthetic results.

E0805.title: Web UI not installed
E0805.fix: Install the extra: `uv add 'autan[ui]'` (or `uv sync --extra ui` in a checkout).

E0807.title: No GPU device
E0807.fix: Run on a host with a GPU visible to the process (`docker --gpus`), or use `devices.kind = cpu`.

E0808.title: No MPI launcher
E0808.fix: Install a GPU-aware MPI (Open MPI or MPICH built with CUDA support), set `$AUTAN_MPIEXEC`, or run on one device.

E1001.title: Unsupported kernel construct
E1001.fix: Rewrite the body with the DSL subset of docs/design/kernel-generator.md.

E1002.title: Argument is not a DSL type
E1002.fix: Annotate every argument with a role type (Geom, State, Residual, Param, ...).

E1003.title: Invalid loop binding
E1003.fix: Make the loop's bindings match the body's arguments, their types and the loop kind.

E1004.title: Invalid loop output
E1004.fix: Give the loop outputs that fit its kind (Inc with signs, Write, accumulators).

E1005.title: Invalid control flow in a kernel
E1005.fix: Assign each name and return on every branch, and put no code after return.

E1006.title: Type mismatch in a kernel
E1006.fix: Make the operand shapes and kinds agree.

E1007.title: rel() of a computed value
E1007.fix: Call rel() on Geom arguments as loaded, not on computed values.

E1008.title: Inc target is not an accumulation
E1008.fix: Accumulate with Inc only into Residual datasets.

E1009.title: Invalid kernel module
E1009.fix: Fix the module so it imports and declares at least one loop.

E1010.title: Unknown backend
E1010.fix: Use a backend listed by the generator's --help.

E1011.title: Unknown policy
E1011.fix: Use a policy listed by the generator's --help.

E1012.title: Differentiation not supported
E1012.fix: Differentiate loops with a single output dataset; declare boundary-state loops frozen=True to drop their derivatives knowingly.

E1013.title: Policy not available on the backend
E1013.fix: Use fp32+acc64 or fp32 on Metal; run fp64 on the CPU, CUDA or HIP backends.

E1100.title: Generated loop failed
E1100.fix: Report the message with the kernel and the input that triggered it.

E1101.title: GPU runtime error
E1101.fix: Check the driver and the device with `autan doctor`, then report the message.

E1102.title: Unknown precision policy
E1102.fix: Use one of the precision policies the driver lists.

E1103.title: Unknown race strategy
E1103.fix: Use one of the race strategies the driver lists.

E1104.title: Face scratch too narrow
E1104.fix: Regenerate the loop so its scratch holds every output component per face.

E1105.title: Incidence scratch too narrow
E1105.fix: Size the schedule's incidence scratch for the widest reduction adjoint of the module.

E1106.title: Incidence twins missing
E1106.fix: Set Topology::incidence_twin from autan::kernels::incidence_twins(mesh) and copy it to the device.

E1107.title: Metal runtime error
E1107.fix: Check that the Mac has an Apple GPU with `autan doctor`, then report the message.

E1108.title: Strategy not available
E1108.fix: Use a deterministic strategy (coloured, store-gather, gather-recompute) or fp32.

E1109.title: Strategy not rank-independent
E1109.fix: Use store-gather or gather-recompute, whose per-cell order is the global one, or build the topology without the global order.
